DeqDeq-Bench: Moroccan Darija Reasoning Benchmark
	


	
		
		Dataset Summary
	

DeqDeq-Bench is a specialized evaluation dataset designed to test the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Moroccan Darija (Arabic Script). 
Unlike standard translation datasets, this benchmark focuses on culturally specific logic, mathematical conversions unique to Morocco, and dialectal reasoning chains (CoT).
